meta.title: Electric Charge Converter — Convert Coulomb and More
meta.description: Free electric charge converter for 8+ units including Coulomb, Millicoulomb, Microcoulomb. Instant, accurate, browser-based.

content.intro: Coulomb, ampere-hour, electron charge. Convert between 8 electric charge units instantly, with engineering-grade precision and no signup required.
content.result_section: Pick any two units below to convert between them. The base unit for electric charge in this tool is **C**; every conversion routes through it for consistency.
content.formula_section: Most electric charge conversions are a single multiplication by a fixed factor. Temperature is the notable exception — it uses additive offsets, not just multiplication. The converter handles both transparently.

content.tips:
Bookmark the conversions you use most — each pair has its own dedicated page with formulas, a lookup table, and FAQs.

When working with derived units (area, volume), remember the factor scales with the dimension: a length factor f becomes f² for area and f³ for volume.
content.faq:
**Q:** How accurate is this electric charge converter?
**A:** It uses 8 canonical unit definitions and 12-digit precision constants.

**Q:** Is it free?
**A:** Yes — completely free, no signup, no limits.

**Q:** Which units are supported?
**A:** Coulomb (C), Millicoulomb (mC), Microcoulomb (µC), Nanocoulomb (nC), Kilocoulomb (kC), Ampere-hour (Ah), Milliampere-hour (mAh), Electron charge (e).
